title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on self-reliance and service
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on the importance of self-reliance and service to others:
"स्वाधीनैव समृद्धिर्जनोपजीव्यत्वमुच्छ्रयश्छाया।
सत्पुंसो मरुभूरिव जीवनमात्रं समाशास्यम्॥"
It conveys the message that true prosperity lies in self-reliance, while true elevation lies in becoming a source of sustenance and support for others.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
स्वाधीनैव समृद्धिर्जनोपजीव्यत्वमुच्छ्रयश्छाया।
सत्पुंसो मरुभूरिव जीवनमात्रं समाशास्यम्॥
स्वाधीनैव समृद्धिर्जनोपजीव्यत्वमुच्छ्रयश्छाया। सत्पुंसो मरुभूरिव जीवनमात्रं समाशास्यम्॥ pic.twitter.com/KTlxVofSBs — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 18, 2026
